paper: Relative Advantage Debiasing for Watch-Time Prediction in Short-Video Recommendation
method: Map play time to train-only user- and video-conditional empirical quantiles, then learn the relative-preference signal in a separate stage.
fit: Distinct from watch_ratio and CWM: it removes both user watch-habit and item-duration/popularity confounding.
smallest_ablation: Completed: fused user/video watch quantiles as a DeepFM auxiliary target, alpha-zero control, pure RAD-head ranking, and train-only head-mix scan.
risk: The alpha-zero control outperformed the RAD auxiliary on both tiers; pure RAD-head ranking scored 0.583969 internally and every held-out residual fold regressed. Do not repeat without a materially different stage-1 estimator or backbone.

paper: UMRE: A Unified Monotonic Transformation for Ranking Ensemble in Recommender Systems
method: Learn monotonic transformations of diverse objective scores, then fuse them with lightweight personalized weights.
fit: The frozen champion relies on linear rank consensus; RRF failed, but learned monotonic score-region weighting is mathematically different.
smallest_ablation: Fit train-only monotonic spline/isotonic transforms for three diverse frozen scores, followed by a strongly regularized user-context gate.
risk: Requires aligned out-of-time scores for every component and strict cross-fitting to avoid a flexible stacker leak.

method: Optimize direct YetiRank NDCG or StochasticRank NDCG@5 instead of pairwise YetiRank.
fit: Targets the official top-five metric without changing the frozen batch-slate features.
smallest_ablation: Completed with YetiRank:mode=NDCG;top=5 and StochasticRank:metric=NDCG;top=5, both residual-initialized and from-scratch where appropriate.
risk: Both objectives gained about 0.003-0.004 on April 20-21 but reversed below 0.6119 on April 22-28; held-out residual folds disagreed.

paper: DeepFM: A Factorization-Machine based Neural Network for CTR Prediction
method: Add nested 25/50/75 percent progress-to-long-view binary auxiliary heads and discard them at inference.
fit: Gives near-threshold watch outcomes denser ordered supervision than a single hard long_view label.
smallest_ablation: Completed with temporal epoch selection, full refit, global residual audit, and an 18-second long-video gate.
risk: The screen reached 0.615249, but the fixed confirmation blend scored 0.612857 and both residual audits retained regressing folds.

paper: CAAFE: Context-Aware Automated Feature Engineering for Tabular Datasets
method: Join organizer user attributes and learn profile-item interactions in CatBoost and DeepFM.
fit: The starter encoder omits all user profile columns, making this a genuine semantic feature ablation.
smallest_ablation: Completed with profile CatBoost, profile plus user-ID CatBoost, one-seed profile DeepFM, low-history routing, and a three-seed profile ensemble.
risk: The best fixed micro-gain was 0.612877, but held-out user folds regressed; do not promote or repeat without a materially different validation protocol.

paper: Conservative Doubly Robust Learning for Debiased Recommendation
method: Filter uncertain error imputations in doubly robust learning using their estimated mean and variance.
fit: Directly evaluated on KuaiRand with biased training and random-exposure evaluation data.
smallest_ablation: Only after rebuilding a valid random-log screen: compare DR against conservative uncertainty filtering.
risk: This challenge validates on standard logs, so optimizing toward the random-log distribution can reduce the official score.

paper: SetRank: Learning a Permutation-Invariant Ranking Model for Information Retrieval
method: Encode a candidate set with permutation-invariant self-attention before producing item scores.
fit: Matches the evaluator's whole-user slate, particularly long slates where nDCG degrades.
smallest_ablation: Replace mean-pooled DeepSets context with one low-rank self-attention block while keeping BCE and temporal selection fixed.
risk: The mean-pooled slate model and prior causal Transformers failed; CPU cost and instability are material.

paper: From RankNet to LambdaRank to LambdaMART: An Overview
method: Gradient-boosted trees with metric-weighted pair gradients.
smallest_ablation: None: CatBoost YetiRank and XGBoost LambdaMART were already audited.
risk: Best XGBoost seed was 0.611949 standalone and selected zero residual.

paper: Counteracting Duration Bias in Video Recommendation via Counterfactual Watch Time
method: Model censored watch time counterfactually rather than treating completion as an exact preference value.
fit: Published KuaiRand relevance-ranking gains motivated the existing survival experiments.
risk: CWM likelihood, censored mixture survival, and duration-regime variants already failed stable promotion.

paper: Modeling Task Relationships in Multi-task Learning with Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts
method: Use task-specific gates over shared experts for multiple feedback signals.
smallest_ablation: Only revisit with a new target such as RAD quantiles.
risk: Generic multi-task and MMoE controls have already regressed.
